new_today_news.headline: Korea to Test Turning Fryer Scraps Into Jet Fuel Feedstock
new_today_news.summary: South Korea's government is launching a pilot project to extract oil from deep-frying residue and use it as feedstock for sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) as a 1% SAF blending mandate takes effect next year. The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment will accept applications from September 16 through October 30 for three regulatory sandbox projects focused on circular economy practices.

new_today_news.headline: Managing Used Cooking Oil: What Food Truck Operators Need to Know in 2026
new_today_news.summary: Food truck operators are increasingly subject to FOG compliance requirements and UCO management obligations. The article discusses how improper grease disposal is an EPA-identified environmental concern driving municipal enforcement, and how UCO management is now a regulated waste stream affecting operations.

new_today_news.headline: September 2026 Fire Report: Waste and Recycling Facility Fires Reach Year-to-Date High
new_today_news.summary: 49 fires at waste and recycling facilities in August 2026 tied August 2025 for the highest August total in 10 years, bringing the year-to-date count to 293 fires, the third-highest January-August total on record. Industry data tracking shows sustained risk in facility operations.
